prompt: Keys are inserted into an empty binary search tree in this order. Duplicates are ignored. Smaller keys go left, larger keys go right.
explain: 5 is the root. 3 goes left of 5, 8 goes right, 1 goes left of 3. 4 is less than 5 (go left), then greater than 3 (go right), so it is the right child of 3. The second 3 is a duplicate and is dropped. Levels: {5}, {3, 8}, {1, 4}, so the height is 3, and in-order always lists keys ascending.
